entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.11+ fails to load on RHEL 8 (GLIBC_2.33 not found) #39148
  • ToString() on an enum with a string value converter fails in projections on EF 11 ("No coercion operator is defined"), possible regression from #38156 #39146

Closed

  • Precompiled Queries fail for captured parameters #35887
    12.0-preview1
  • GroupBy and sum issues #33663
    12.0-preview1
  • SqlServer: KeyNotFoundException in RewriteOperations when a temporal table is renamed into the model's default schema #38601
    12.0-preview1
  • Where_compare_constructed_multi_value_not_equal: anonymous object equality should use value semantics #36412
    12.0-preview1
  • JSON-absent required complex collection materializes as null under ComplexProperty().ToJson(), then throws InvalidOperationException in PrepareToSave on save #38625
    12.0-preview1
  • PMC: Set PublishAot=false when building the project #35526
    12.0-preview1
  • Precompiled query generation emits expression variable names verbatim, producing invalid C# for names that are not identifiers #39061
    12.0-preview1
  • EF11 Regression: EF.Parameter/EF.Constant on a context property in a query filter now throws (non-compiled queries) #39081
    11.0.0
  • EF Core 11 relational regression: `ExecuteUpdate` prunes its update-target join #39124
    11.0.0
  • .NET 11 RC1 - SQLite: index on a member of a JSON-mapped complex type indexes the whole column #39064
    11.0.0
  • .NET 11 RC1 - SQL Server: `IsUnique()` on an index over a JSON-mapped member is silently dropped #39065
    11.0.0
  • string.StartsWith(char) with wild char translates to incorrect LIKE pattern on SQL Server #38923
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Parse the identity seed as a long when generating DBCC CHECKIDENT on SQL Server #39157
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26473.115 to 11.0.0-beta.26501.5 #39156
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.Extensions.Azure from 7.1.0 to 7.1.1 #39155
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Data.SqlClient from 7.1.0 to 7.1.1 #39154
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.63.1 to 3.63.2 #39153
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Grpc.AspNetCore from 2.83.0 to 2.84.0 #39152
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump actions/upload-code-coverage from 1.4.2 to 1.4.3 #39151
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39147

Merged

  • Query: read nullable value-type GroupBy keys as nullable on the client #39098
    community-contribution
  • Fix precompiled queries not capturing parameter symbol #39149
    community-contribution
  • Don't derive NULLIF nullability from its first argument #39102
    community-contribution
  • Unescape doubled single quotes in scaffolded string default values #39101
    community-contribution
  • Key temporal table map removals by the raw schema in SqlServerMigrationsSqlGenerator #39099
    community-contribution
  • Change Where_compare_constructed_multi_value_not_equal to use value comparison #39150
    community-contribution
  • Materialize required collections absent from a JSON document as empty #39014
    community-contribution
  • PMC: Set PublishAot=false when building the project #39111
    community-contribution
  • Escape all Unicode line separators in CSharpHelper string and char literals #38711
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Sqlite: Don't fold a filtered subquery into a join whose key is an equality b… #39103
    community-contribution
  • Escape LIKE wildcard chars correctly in SQL Server StartsWith(char) #39076
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Translate byte[].Contains with a non-constant byte to a one-byte BLOB… #39106
    community-contribution
  • Sanitize expression variable names when generating precompiled query code #39062
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Update stale nested complex collection entries during Update on a shortened collection #39092
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.15
  • [release/10.0] Fix Contains handling for read-only collections #39114
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.15
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.63.1 to 3.63.2 #39142
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39097

Updated

  • Write the entry that owns the ordinal in JSON collection element updates #39140
    community-contribution
  • Translate string.TrimStart/TrimEnd with a char parameter instead of d… #39105
    community-contribution
  • Inline char constants as Unicode string literals in SQL Server IndexO… #39104
    community-contribution
  • Implement SqliteCommand.Cancel() and honor CancellationToken while executing (#38757) #39110
    community-contribution
  • Bump the npm group in /eng/harness-evaluation with 2 updates #39115
    area-infrastructure, area-harness
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39145
  • [release/11.0] Update xUnit v3 to 4.0.1 #39144
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix and extend single-result subquery lifting #39107
    community-contribution
  • Add experimental ExecuteMerge / upsert support #39100
    community-contribution
